name: Spider, Advanced Elite Monstrous Funnel Web
body:
Biggin’
CR 7

XP 3,200
Advanced HD elite monstrous funnel web spider
N Huge Vermin
Init +4 Senses darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 60 ft., Perception +10

DEFENSE

AC 17, touch 12, flat-footed 13 (+4 Dex, +5 natural, -2 size)
hp 133 (14d8+70)

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., climb 20 ft.
Melee Bite +14 (2d6+9+poison)
Space 15 ft.; Reach 10 ft.
Special Attacks poison (injury; save Fort Dc 22, frequency 1/round for 4 rounds; effect 1d4 Strength damage; cure 1 save); Web (+12 ranged, DC 22, 14 hp)

STATISTICS

Str 23, Dex 19, Con 20, Int -, Wis 12, Cha 2
Base Atk +10; CMB +18; CMD 32 (36 vs. trip)
Feats None
Skills Climb +30, Perception +10, Stealth +10 (+14 in webs); Racial Modifiers +16 Climb, +4 Perception, +4 Stealth, +4 to Stealth in webs
Languages none

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Poison (Ex)

Poison (Ex) Bite – injury; save Fort Dc 22, frequency 1/round for 4 rounds; effect 1d4 Strength damage; cure 1 save.
